title: A Study to Assess the Safety and Efficacy of a Single Dose of UBX0101 in Patients With Osteoarthritis of the Knee

sections.abstract:
A study to assess efficacy, safety, and tolerability of a single-dose intra-articular administration of UBX0101 in patients with moderate to severe painful knee osteoarthritis (OA).

Posted outcomes: Change From Baseline to Week 12 of the Western Ontario and McMaster Universities Osteoarthritis Index Pain Subscale (WOMAC-A) Score in Patients Receiving a Sing. timeframe=Baseline to Week 12. Placebo=2.20 (±0.577); UBX0101 0.5 mg=2.05 (±0.509); UBX0101 2.0 mg=2.08 (±0.658)
